item.title: Recent News
item.description:
Recent News
  • (2025/07/10) IBM named a leader in 2025 Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Observability Platforms. Announcement [2025]
  • (2025/07/19) Talk at the University of British Columbia on ITBench.
  • (2025/06/09) ITBench accepted at ICML 2025 as a spotlight (oral) paper. Paper Link Code Oral CIO Coverage IBM Research
  • (2025/06/27) ITBench tutorial at DSN 2025. Tutorial
  • (2025/05/02) ITBench leaderboard service released. Benchmark your agents now! Leaderboard
  • (2025/06/26) Our paper "Story of Two GPUs: Characterizing the Resilience of Hopper H100 and Ampere A100 GPUs" accepted at SC 2025! This study analyzes GPU resilience in a large-scale AI system with 1,056 GPUs.
  • Queue management for LLM inference accepted at SoCC 2024 Paper link
  • (2024/04/18) Our work on probable root cause identification was integrated into Instana as an innovative feature, now available in tech preview for select customers. Announcement Interview
  • (2024/05/01) "Power-aware Deep Learning Model Serving with μ-Serve" accepted at ATC 2024.
    Paper link
  • (2024/04/31) "iPrism: Characterize and Mitigate Risk by Quantifying Change in Escape Routes" accepted at DSN 2024. This work is based on my PhD dissertation.
  • (2024/02/23) Our work on GenAI observability was integrated as an innovative feature in Instana, now available in tech preview for select customers.
    Announcement
  • (2024/01/25) Selected to participate IBM Tech 2024; <0.01% of IBMers are selected. IBM Tech 2024 is IBM's premier recognition, education, and development program for top technical IBMers who have made vital contributions to some of IBM's most innovative and impactful technologies.
  • (2024/01/03) Appointed as Research Product Focal (PI) for IBM Instana, I will collaborate with both IBM Research and the Instana teams to reimagine and innovate the observability platform, in addition to my existing responsibilities. Read about IBM Instana here.
  • (2022/11/04) Distinguished Reviewer Award, ISSRE 2022. award link
  • (2022/06/03) Best presentation award for our work on disaggregated memory systems video award link
  • (2022/05/12) Paper accepeted at CLOUD'22.
  • (2022/03/15) Paper accepeted at DSN'22. Preprint
  • (2022/03/08) Paper accepeted at CompSys'22 co-located with IPDPS'22.
  • (2021/11/01) Joined IBM Research.
  • (2021/12/16) Ph.D. degree awarded.
  • (2021/10/14) Passed doctoral final exam.
  • Won best paper award for our ISSRE 2020 paper assessing self-driving cars.
  • SC 2020 paper nominated for both the best paper and the best student paper.
  • Co-created "Dependable AI" course with my advisor. Suggestions are welcome.
  • Honored to be named the 2020 IBM Ph.D. Fellow
  • Bayesian Fault Injector (DSN 2019) designed for assessing autonomous vehicles received world-wide press coverage: Science Daily, Daily Illini , Guancha.cn, Space Daily, Eureka Alert, Sina
